shortDescription: A 16-week powerlifting peaking program using percentage-based and RPE-based loading across 4 phases, with very high bench frequency (4x/week) and competition-specific exercise selection.
descriptionHtml: A 16-week powerlifting peaking program using percentage-based and RPE-based loading across 4 phases, with very high bench frequency (4x/week) and competition-specific exercise selection.
author: Bryce Krawczyk
